best_section.where: kerb beside the bowls greens and tennis courts, about two-thirds of the way along Keith St from the Sir Fred Schonell Dr corner, opposite the sports centre car park

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bowls greens and tennis courts behind a hedge, not house frontages; the nearest OSM houses sit 80m+ further up the street, well clear of this stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane screened by a continuous tree/hedge row, no driveways crossing it here, and plenty of straight room for a long van.
drivers.traffic: Three lanes and a signed 50 km/h limit make it feel like a service loop for the sports precinct rather than a quiet residential street, but other cars already park here.
drivers.convention: 2025 Esri imagery shows cars parked nose-to-tail along this exact stretch, so a van parked here matches what's already happening (2022 QLD imagery shows the lane empty, so uptake may vary).

flags: Local dip to roughly 10% grade near the 200 m mark; the rest of the section is a gentle 1-5%
Acts as a loop/service road for the sports precinct, so some traffic is possible after dark
sun_shade: Overhung by the roadside tree/hedge canopy on the sports-field side for most of the day; little direct sun reaches the kerb.
cannot_judge: Kerb height and crossfall for levelling the van
Whether on-site signage adds restrictions beyond the sign screen
Actual night-time traffic volume on this loop road
reasons: Backs onto sports fields, not houses
Cars already park along this stretch
Long straight kerb with room to pull in
summary: Secluded, tree-shaded kerb beside bowls and tennis courts where cars already park overnight.
